script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let v3 be this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "totalBattlePhaseTurn").
Let v4 be _ → find with (list3, given (x) { Return not not call game:ai.AiUtil.checkTurnForceAbilityConf with (v3, x) and this state → is-there-enable-ability-target-with-cond-reflection with (arg, x). }, this state).
Return v4 or call game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransition.helper.getForceAbilityConf with (arg).
